There will need to be some powerful over-the-horizon emitters to help it achieve orbit. Probably some white graphene shielding. Lots of shielding. This in theory will work, and cheaply too once the power commitments are satisfied - think geo-thermal or hydro, not nukes.

It's a very cool concept. The creation of the phased array sounds a bit tough and I would imagine the heat exchanger will be a critical piece as well. I suspect the ground development and testing is going to be comparatively easy on the other hand.
